verdict.rationale: Probes with a standard identified pipeline user agent got HTTP 403 at robots.txt on both the Secretary of State's own site (www.ohiosos.gov) and its Ohio Business Central filing portal (bsportal.ohiosos.gov). The portal also flapped to a 404 on one same-day request. That is a front-door wall in front of the SOS's public reading surface. The only reachable pages in the pack belong to different state properties (the Ohio Business Gateway and the Department of Taxation), so they say nothing about the SOS's own guidance pages and cannot be credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
